newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli troops kill Arab in West Bank.
newsitem.headline: Israeli troops kill Arab in West Bank.

text.p: Israeli troops shot and killed a Palestinian and wounded two others on Sunday in a village just west of Hebron in the West Bank, Palestinian sources and the Israeli army said.
The Palestinian sources said an Israeli patrol entered Haras village and opened fire when Palestinians threw stones, killing one man and wounding two. The army confirmed the report.
Hospital officials in Hebron identified the dead man as Issam Akabneh, 18.
About 5,000 people chanting "Revenge in Tel Aviv" and "Go Forward Hamas" attended Akabaneh's funeral at Haras several hours after the shooting.

Islamic Resistance Movement Hamas militants have in the past several years killed scores of Israelis in bombings in the Jewish state. The last such attack killed three Israeli women in Tel Aviv on March 21.
The Haras incident came as Israeli-Palestinian peacemaking remained in deep crisis over Israel's beginning a new Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem on March 18.
For weeks after groundbreaking for the 6,500-unit settlement Palestinians throwing stones battled Israeli troops in the West Bank. The unrest had abated somewhat in the last week.
Palestinian President Yasser Arafat on Sunday described as "a barbaric, shameful act" the stabbing to death of two Israeli women whose bodies were found in the West Bank on Friday.
Arafat said Israeli and Palestinian officers met to discuss the issue. Israeli police said they were investigating whether the killers were Palestinian guerrillas.
